firstPlayerRule: Choose a starting witch; the rulebook suggests the player who last visited a forest as an example.
clarifications: The forest-visit criterion is an example, not a requirement.
During setup, character cards are chosen beginning with the player to the starting witch's right and proceeding counterclockwise.
The starting witch takes the first game turn, followed by the other players clockwise.
internalEvidence: Visually checked publisher-authored Lookout English booklet pages 3–4, preserved by the Dice Tower Library. Setup step 7 leaves the starter selection open and gives a recent forest visit only as an example; step 8 reverses the character-card selection order, while play itself proceeds clockwise.
